title: Efficacy and safety of Programmed Death Ligand 1 inhibitors <i>versus</i> Programmed Death 1 inhibitors in the first-line treatment of advanced non-small cell lung cancer: a meta-analysis of randomized controlled trials.

answer.design_quote: A meta-analysis of randomized controlled trials (RCTs) that investigated the efficacy and safety of PD-L1 or PD-1 inhibitors alone or in combination with chemotherapy in the first-line treatment of patients with advanced, treatment-naïve NSCLC was conducted.
answer.k_quote: In total, 28 RCTs involving 14,758 patients were included.
